title: Rear searchlight: what should it do for the player?
body:
What the player sees today: the rear gun fires at what's behind the train, and there's no searchlight to help you see it. The fortress's shop (queue #410, note 678), the train upgrades you asked for on 13 Oct, is meant to sell one, but the sim has no way of giving a light a job. Only the Fire Flies and the Interior threats react to light. A purchase that does nothing is a bug by the project's rule, so it isn't on sale.

What it could do, each with a gameplay effect, is below. Time is small to medium.

Decision: pick what the searchlight is for.

Default meanwhile: it stays unbuilt and off the shelf. U1's other tools (cowcatcher, grab irons, armour, flare pistol) don't wait on it.

options.label: A real light cone on the van
options.detail: The beam shows light-sensing creatures, so the Fire Flies are drawn to the back of the train: a cost for owning it, not a tool. Cheapest.

options.label: A 'spotted' call on the HUD
options.detail: A gunner sees a callout for any creature inside the beam, so it's a real tool for the rear gun. Needs new network state and tests; most work.

options.label: Look only, with a tally line
options.detail: A lamp on the van that lights the track behind. No sim change, so the yard clerk reads a joke line in the nightly tally. Silliest, cheapest, no help in play.

options.label: Drop it
options.detail: Not sold. The money goes to other tools.
